messages:
sam: customer report: resumed stream + prefetch double-confirmed the same prefix. repro attached.
noor: logs plz.
sam: ```
2026-03-28T21:03:10.000Z [router] session=s1 event=provisional prefix=72 tx=R123
2026-03-28T21:03:10.007Z [prefetch] session=s1 event=provisional prefix=72 tx=P456
2026-03-28T21:03:10.020Z [ledger] confirm tx=R123 tokens=72
2026-03-28T21:03:10.022Z [ledger] confirm tx=P456 tokens=72
``` 
sam: ledger shows both confirms => double billing.
chip: this is the router vs prefetch race we've seen. two distinct provisional ids get confirmed.
maria: console hides provisional origins now. ops only sees final counts so it's hard to triage.
noor: short-term mitigation: make prefetch tag provisional as "tentative" and require router handshake to confirm. cheap and low-risk.
chip: long-term: ledger should canonicalize confirms per (session, prefix-range) within a small time window and prefer router-origin when present.
billing-bot: created billing-alert session=s1 delta=+72
ops-bot: noted.
maria: UX: add a per-session event timeline that shows provisional tx ids, source, and confirm events so ops can eyeball duplicates quickly.
noor: telemetry: add metric double_confirm_rate and reconciler_rewrites to detect regressions after mitigation.
chip: implementation notes: canonicalization rule: if multiple confirms overlap by >=50% of prefix range within 1s for same session, collapse to a single canonical confirm and emit reconciliation audit events.
sam: i'll draft RFC with repro, tentative prefetch patch, and ledger canonicalization design. aim for EU canary next week.
maria: i'll prototype console timeline mock and API for reconciler audit events.
chip: add unit tests for overlapping-range detection and a small perf test for reconciliation path.
noor: also add an alert that fires if confirmed_tokens - max(provisional_by_router) > threshold in 5m to catch escapes.
sam: thanks all. will attach repro to RFC. ping to pair on canary.
